context: Guards the most common regression: on a fresh rebrand request the agent must confirm the demo, check/create the branch, and COPY existing DA content into /acme BEFORE invoking the design tool or editing styling files, and must never ask the customer about a Settings/LLM-Permissions screen. Access starts with only DA_TOKEN in token.env; the workflow derives the publish token itself.

checklist.name: Copies DA content into the company folder before any design work
checklist.description: Before invoking the design tool or editing styling files, the agent copies the existing DA content into /acme (runs the DA copy flow), non-destructively; it does not assume the content is empty.

checklist.name: Does not invoke the design tool / edit CSS before branch + copy
checklist.description: The agent does not call excat-complete-design-expert or edit styles.css / sweep asset colors until the demo branch is created and DA content is copied.

checklist.name: Confirms the demo and creates a branch (no fork)
checklist.description: The agent frames the work as a rebranded copy under Acme's name and creates/checks out a branch of the current repo (deriving org/repo from origin), not a fork.

checklist.name: No Settings / permissions question
checklist.description: The agent never asks the customer to open a Settings, LLM Permissions, or permissions/admin screen; access starts with only DA_TOKEN in token.env.

checklist.name: No manual Helix token ask
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer for HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN or browser x-auth-token; the active workflow derives the publish token from DA_TOKEN.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No 'fork', 'branch', 'daFolder', 'excat', or phase names surfaced to the customer as mechanics.
